title: Monster Chef
lore: You are a veritable dungeon gourmand.
body: Cook 1–3 monster parts to grant one 1-floor buff: +1d4 attack; +1d6 AC (max 18); heal 1d8 + party size; or gain a chosen damage resistance. Choose a check: Cooking (Con) normal; Culinary Intuition (Int/Wis) gives advantage or improves the effect; Risky Delicacy (Cha DC 16) adds +1d6 temp HP on success, or nausea (disadvantage on one roll) on failure. On a natural 1, the dish spoils: each party member makes a DC 12 Con save or is poisoned for one floor.

title: Forbidden Revival
lore: Dark magic bends death itself to your will, but power always demands payment.
body: Once per two floors, you may perform a ritual to revive a dead party member or significant NPC. They return fully restored, but exhausted; the exhaustion ends after a long rest (meal) or on entering the next floor.

title: People Skills
lore: You understand humans in ways others don't—their motivations, fears, and weaknesses.
body: Once per day, you have advantage on one social check (Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation) against a humanoid enemy or NPC. This applies in dialogue and in combat improvisation checks against humanoids.

title: Passage Finding
assigned_to: The rogue or most dexterous character
lore: Your keen senses reveal hidden paths and deadly mechanisms.
body: Once per floor, spend 10 minutes searching for hidden passages, traps, or hazards. Make an Investigation check (DC 12). Success: discover a useful feature (shortcut, disarmable trap, safe route, or extra resources like food/treasure/monster parts). Failure: trigger a minor trap (1d6 damage), but you learn its location.

title: Iaijutsu
lore: Your training in the Eastern Archipelago has focused your mind, and now your mind focuses your blade.
body: Before attacking a designated non-boss, make a Dex check vs DC 12 + the target’s proficiency (min 12). Success: the target drops to 0 HP. Failure: you still hit and deal double damage.

title: Cursed Instinct
lore: Your curse grants you beastly abilities incompatible with your human self. Your soul is melded with that of a beast, and both halves of you now share one life.
body: Once per floor, when combat is about to begin, you automatically win initiative for that encounter and act first. After using this, you roll initiative normally for the rest of the floor (and beyond).

title: Monsterologist
lore: Your love of monsters is so great that you once considered studying to become a monster researcher.
body: Once per floor, ask the DM three questions about a monster (weaknesses, HP, upcoming encounters, or other relevant details). The answers are mostly perfectly detailed.

title: Weapons Expert
usage_label: Upon finding a weapon, once per floor
lore: Your relatives were weapons dealers; growing up, you saw every variety of arms used by tall-men, dwarves, and elves. Curiosity became skill, obsession, and an unshakable urge to fuss over other people’s weapons.
body: Upon finding a weapon in the dungeon, you may restore it to proper working order and choose one permanent upgrade: (1) Sharp Edge: +1 damage. (2) Crossguard: +1 AC while Dodging or vs opportunity attacks. (3) Weighted Head: double damage to objects/structures.

title: Summoner
assigned_to: A Mage or Cleric (elves may also summon a fairy)
lore: During your magical studies, one of your favorite electives was summoning. You dabbled in familiars of all shapes and sizes, but you think you’ve finally found your favorite.
body: Spend 1 Meal Meter to summon a familiar (ritual). Choose: Raven (AC 15, HP 4, speed 60 ft, darkvision; Peck +4 to hit, 1d4; you can use its senses). If you’re an elf, you may instead summon a Fairy (AC 15, HP 4, speed 30 ft; no attacks; you gain advantage on magic and it can communicate for you).
